title: Sylvas: Synergistic Learning Value based Device Scheduling in Federated Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.15763v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated continual learning (FCL) enables shared global models to continuously adapt to distributed and non-stationary data streams, making it important for Internet of Things applications such as intelligent transportation, industrial monitoring, and unmanned systems. Under spatio-temporal data distribution dynamics and label scarcity, a key challenge is how to quantify the contribution of each edge device to global learning performance and schedule the most valuable devices under resource constraints for timely model updating. This article presents Sylvas, a synergistic learning value based device scheduling framework for FCL at the wireless edge. translated_title: Sylvas：基于协同学习价值的联邦持续学习设备调度
translated_abstract: 联邦持续学习（FCL）使共享的全局模型能够持续适应分布式和非平稳的数据流，这使其在智能交通、工业监测和无人系统等物联网应用中具有重要意义。在时空数据分布动态变化和标签稀缺的条件下，一个关键挑战是如何量化每个边缘设备对全局学习性能的贡献，并在资源约束下调度最有价值的设备以实现及时的模型更新。本文提出了Sylvas，一个面向无线边缘联邦持续学习的基于协同学习价值的设备调度框架。Sylvas从两个角度评估分布式数据的学习价值：分布价值，从时空分布的角度刻画设备数据对全局模型学习的贡献；标签价值，捕捉标签的数量和可靠性……
tldr: 本文提出Sylvas框架，通过协同学习价值（结合刻画数据时空分布贡献的分布价值和衡量标签数量与可靠性的标签价值）来量化边缘设备的贡献，从而在资源约束下调度最有价值的设备以支持无线边缘的联邦持续学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Sylvas, a device scheduling framework for federated continual learning at the wireless edge that quantifies each edge device's contribution through synergistic learning value—combining distributional value (spatio-temporal data contribution) and label value (quantity and reliability)—to schedule the most valuable devices under resource constraints.
